# Data

```{r data}
# List every file the report reads, so the checksum table below covers all of them.
input_files <- c(
  password=file.path(data_dir,"password.txt"),
  codebook=file.path(data_dir,"Codebook.csv"),
  Codebook_choices=file.path(data_dir,"Codebook_choices.csv"),
  raw = file.path(data_dir,"Paraneoplastic_DATA_RAW_2026-1-21_Collaborative Data.xlsx")
  )
password <- readLines(input_files[["password"]])
dat <- readxl::read_xlsx(input_files[["raw"]], password = password)
cb <- read.csv(input_files[["codebook"]], check.names = FALSE)
```

## File md5sum

```{r input-files, eval=TRUE}
print(data.frame(file = unname(input_files), bytes = file.size(input_files),
                 md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_files))), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Data overview

```{r data-overview, eval=TRUE}
cat("Rows:", nrow(dat), "\nVariables:", ncol(dat), "\n\n")
data.frame(
  variable = names(dat),
  class = vapply(dat, function(x) class(x)[1], character(1)),
  n_missing = colSums(is.na(dat)),
  n_distinct = vapply(dat, dplyr::n_distinct, integer(1)),
  row.names = NULL
) |>
  print(row.names = FALSE)
```


# Results

Tables @tbl-grouped-important and @tbl-grouped-other compare patients with and without a
paraneoplastic syndrome (PNS). Patients with missing `pns` are excluded. The PNS block (`pns`
to `time_resolution_pth`) is not compared, since those fields define or follow from the group.
Categorical variables with more than 10 levels show the 9 most frequent plus "Other (pooled)".

```{r grouped-setup}
# Important variables named by Bo, as codebook names (checkbox variables expand to all columns)
important_vars <- c(
  "tumor_type", "histology", "inpc_classification", "extent_of_resection",
  "age_diagnosis", "inrgss", "risk_group", "mync", "sca", "primary_tumor_location",
  "mets_response_chemo", "d1", "d2", "d3", "d1_preop", "d2_preop", "d3_preop",
  "labs_diagnosis", "labs_preop",
  "surgery_performed", "age_surgery", "weight_surgery", "volume_blood_loss",
  "surgical_los", "postop_complications",
  "chemo", "cog_enrollment", "cog_protocol", "preoop_chemo_cycles",
  "chemo_to_surgery", "surgery_to_chemo",
  # All IDRF fields
  setdiff(cb$variable[cb$form_name == "idrfs_optional"], "idrfs_optional_complete")
)

dat_grouped <- dat |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pns)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pns_group = factor(pns, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No PNS", "PNS"))) |>
  # Drop the identifier and the PNS block
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("record_id"), -(pns:time_resolution_pth), pns_group)

is_important <- sub("___.*$", "", names(dat_grouped)) %in% important_vars
important_cols <- names(dat_grouped)[is_important]
other_cols <- setdiff(names(dat_grouped), c(important_cols, "pns_group"))

grouped_table <- function(cols, data = dat_grouped, by = "pns_group") {
  data |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(cols), dplyr::any_of(by)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::where(\(x) is.numeric(x) && dplyr::n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE) <= 10 &&
                     all(x == round(x), na.rm = TRUE)),
      factor
    )) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::where(\(x) (is.character(x) || is.factor(x)) && dplyr::n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 10),
      \(x) forcats::fct_lump_n(factor(x), n = 9, other_level = "Other (pooled)", ties.method = "first")
    )) |>
    gtsummary::tbl_summary(by = dplyr::any_of(by), missing = "ifany", missing_text = "Missing") |>
    (\(t) if (length(by)) gtsummary::add_overall(t, last = FALSE) else t)() |>
    gtsummary::bold_labels() |>
    gtsummary::as_gt() |>
    style_gt()
}
```

::: {.report-table .table-standard}

## Table 1: important variables

```{r}
#| label: tbl-grouped-important
#| tbl-cap: "Group by PNS status: important variables."
grouped_table(important_cols)
```
:::

::: {.report-table .table-standard}

## Table 1: all other variables

```{r}
#| label: tbl-grouped-other
#| tbl-cap: "Group by PNS status: all other variables."
grouped_table(other_cols)
```
:::


## Table 2: PNS fields

@tbl-pns summarizes the PNS fields (`date_symptom_onset` to `time_resolution_pth`) among the
patients with PNS. These fields are only recorded for PNS patients, so there is no comparison
group. Fields with no recorded value (all missing) are left out.

```{r pns-setup}
pns_data <- dat |>
  dplyr::filter(pns %in% 1) |>
  dplyr::select(date_symptom_onset:time_resolution_pth) |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::where(\(x) !all(is.na(x))))
```

::: {.report-table .table-standard}
```{r}
#| label: tbl-pns
#| tbl-cap: "PNS fields among patients with PNS."
grouped_table(names(pns_data), data = pns_data, by = character(0))
```
:::
